Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Control: 3D Gun Effects: Who sets the options

Players choose: everyone uses Options > Mods, the values below are ignored. Server values: everyone uses the values below; the entries in Options > Mods are greyed out or hidden. Key bindings always stay the player's choice.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Tracers: The game's own tracers, drawn in 3D. Look per ammo type.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_TracerP: 3D Gun Effects: Faint bullet path line
The thin fading line from the muzzle to the bullet.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Flash_t: A bright flash at the real muzzle whenever the game shows its own muzzle flash.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Light: 3D Gun Effects: Muzzle flash lights the surroundings
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Light_t: A short warm light at the muzzle for every shot.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Smoke_t: Smoke puffs that start at the muzzle and stay in the world.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_SmokeFP: 3D Gun Effects: Smoke size in first person
Factor on the puff size in first person (third person always 1).
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Impacts: Dust, splinters, sparks and ricochets by material. Size depends on the ammo.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Holes_t: Holes stay on walls and objects, short-lived marks on dirt, grass, sand and snow.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_HoleTim: 1 = about 2 minutes on walls, 25 seconds on the ground; 5 = about 10 / 2 minutes.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_Effects3D_Firefli: On: fireflies drawn in 3D, hidden behind walls. Off: no fireflies in the 3D view.
